notes.title: We are part of the Steam Autumn Sale 2021
notes.content:
Beeware Bee-Friends.

We are part of the Steam Autumn Sale 2021.
Get your copy of our beeautiful tower defense game 40% off now!

True to the game’s motto “Save the Bees!”, players of BeeFense BeeMastered must build an effective defense against varied enemy types in a total of 26 levels — a real BeeFense! In the remastered version of ByteRockers Games’ successful mobile game, the graphics have been revamped from the ground up to shine on PC and console in full HD and with new animations. The content of the humorous tower defense game has also expanded: the story continues in the land of fireflies in six new levels, with new weapons giving the clever little bees more options to trickily defend themselves against their opponents. 

Good defending,

Byterockers‘ Games

notes.title: Bug reporting via Discord possible!
notes.content:
Hey Beefans,

Thank you for all your feedback on Beefense Beemastered. 

Recently, however, a few bugs have appeared that we would like to get rid of as quickly as possible. We would like to offer you two different ways to do this:

1.) On the one hand you can join our [url=https://discord.gg/jzBVVfQPuZ] Discord [/url] to report bugs. Under the text channel "🐞bugs" you can simply report a bug to us with the command !bug. 

2.) On the other hand, if you don't want to go the Discord way, you can also report bugs in the game under the discussion tab [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1640930/discussions/1/] Bugs and Feedback [/url] on Steam.


Good defending,

Byterockers‘ Games

notes.title: BeeFense and BeeFense BeeMastered are now linked!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

the good news first: miracles do indeed still happen. As of now, all BeeFense owners should have the new BeeFense BeeMastered in their library and should be able to install it for free. 

But joking aside. We realize that some things went wrong here. But on the one hand we can't do much without Valve's help and because it' s Summer Sale they will get many thousands of requests (hence the long waiting times) and on the other hand sometimes mistakes are like quicksand: The more you try to fight it, the worse it gets. 
From the beginning, our only thought was to give one of our first games a refresh and give the few loyal fans a gift as a thank you. You have no idea how much this unfortunate chain of mistakes stressed us out ourselves. We have never been so annoyed on any day of BeeFense BeeMastered development.😉


But so be it. Neither are we getting rich from this game, nor did we ever want anyone to get stressed out by us. We now hope that BeeFense BeeMastered does what it's there to do, and that's bring you some "free" joy. 


We thank you (also for the partially nice words) for your patience and now have fun.


ByteRockers' Games

notes.title: We continue to work on the problem
notes.content:
Hello bees friends

unfortunately, sometimes the problem is as deep in the details as it can be. We will continue to work on a solution with Valve over the weekend so that we can link BeeFense and BeeFense BeeMastered. 

Until then, we have a little work around for you that should work. [b]If you own BeeFense[/b], then [b]DISINSTALL[/b] the game once and then [b]INSTALL[/b] it again. Now you should also play BeeFense BeeMastered. But this is only the emergency solution. Once again, we ask you loyal BeeFense owners to wait rather than buy the game. You don't have to! Until next week we will get it "right". Have fun playing the game and thank you for your understanding.

ByteRockers' Games

notes.title: Technical problems when linking BeeFense and BeeFense BeeMastered!
notes.content:
Hello bee fans,

Unfortunately it has happened now and a technical error has occurred. Don't worry it will stay like this: 
[b]All owners of "BeeFense" will get "BeeFense BeeMastered" for free!!![/b]
We are working under high pressure with Valve to solve the problem within the next 24 hours. 
Sorry for the delay, but unfortunately it's the first time for us as an indie studio, 
that we set up such a link. 

Thank you for your understanding!

ByteRockers' Games
